verdict.rationale: The standalone Tax Transactions API explicitly supports recording transactions and handling reversals (refund adjustments), and Stripe Tax offers transaction reports with itemized line-level exports. TaxJar handles US filing. However, no evidence shows that reversals or credit notes carry negative tax amounts into liability, reports, and the next filing without manual fixes. Missing for 10: explicit credit note tax handling, documentation that refunds/negative amounts appear in tax reports and liability, evidence that reversals carry into TaxJar filings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
